findings.evidence: Mathlib/Logic/Equiv/Defs.lean:888 defines `[simp] Quotient.congr_mk`; Mathlib/Topology/Homeomorph/Quotient.lean:43-45 defines the homeomorphism via `Quot.congrRight`, so the new result is `rfl`.
findings.fix: Delete this module/lemma and unfold `Homeomorph.Quotient.congrRight` as needed before using `Quotient.congr_mk` in the sole consumer.
findings.issue: `Homeomorph.Quotient.congrRight_mk` is a thin restatement of Mathlib’s `Quotient.congr_mk`.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/Logic/Equiv/Set.lean:51 has `@[simps! apply] Set.equivOfEq`; Mathlib/Topology/Homeomorph/Lemmas.lean:177 defines `Homeomorph.setCongr` with `toEquiv := Set.equivOfEq h`, making the new theorem an `rfl` wrapper.
findings.fix: Delete this module/lemma and expose the underlying equivalence in the sole consumer before simplifying with `Set.equivOfEq_apply`.
findings.issue: `Homeomorph.setCongr_apply` duplicates Mathlib’s generated `Set.equivOfEq_apply` through the transparent `Homeomorph.setCongr` wrapper.

summary: Two new public evaluation lemmas duplicate existing Mathlib lemmas through transparent homeomorphism wrappers.
